records.text: Job continued and said in his prelude:
“Who might place me in a month of former days, when God guarded me?
Joshua gathered all the tribes of Israel to Shiloh. He summoned their elders, scribes, and judges and made them stand before God.

Joshua said to all the people, “Thus says the Lord, the God of Israel: ‘From the beginning your fathers lived beyond the River—Terah, the father of Abraham and the father of Nahor—and they served other gods.
And Jacob called his sons, and said, “Gather yourselves, that I may tell you what shall befall you in the latter days.
“Assemble and hear, you sons of Jacob; listen to Israel your father.
And Moses spoke in the hearing of all the assembly of Israel the words of this song, even unto the end:
Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and His disciples,
saying, “The scribes and Pharisees have seated themselves in Moses’ chair.
Therefore do and observe everything they tell you, but do not act according to their works, for they say and do not do.
And God put a word in Balaam's mouth and said: Return to Balak and thus you shall speak.
And he returned to him, and there he stood beside his whole burnt offerings, with all the officials of Moab.
And Abraham called the name of that place The Lord Has Seen, that they might say today, “In the mountain the Lord appeared.”
And an angel of the Lord called to Abraham a second time out of the heaven,
For Solomon. God, give Thy judgment to the king, and Thy righteousness to the king’s son,
to judge Thy people in righteousness, and Thy poor in justice.
Let the mountains take up peace for Thy people, and the hills in righteousness.
He will judge the poor of the people, and save the children of the needy, and humble the false accuser,
